faqs.q: How do I find my size?
faqs.a: Sample size guide: our shirts and tees are listed in sizes S to XXL. As a guide, S fits a 38-inch chest, M a 40-inch, L a 42-inch, XL a 44-inch and XXL a 46-inch chest. If you are between sizes or like a relaxed fit, we recommend going one size up. The owner will confirm the final size guide with the real range.

faqs.q: How do I place an order?
faqs.a: Pick a product, choose your size, and tap Add to Cart — or Buy Now to go straight to checkout. Fill in your name, phone number and address, confirm with Cash on Delivery, and your order is placed.

The sample checkout offers Cash on Delivery — you pay in cash when your order arrives at your door, so there is no need to pay anything in advance. The final payment options will be confirmed by the owner.

Orders are confirmed on your phone number first, then dispatched. Delivery across Pakistan usually takes a few working days; the delivery fee at checkout is a sample and will be confirmed with your order.

Under the sample exchange policy, if the size is not right you can contact us with your order number to arrange a size exchange for an unworn item with its tags on. The owner will confirm the final exchange policy.

faqs.q: Are these the final products and prices?
faqs.a: This page is a sample catalogue: the photos are representative sample photos and the prices are sample prices. The owner will confirm the final product range and prices — everything marked as a sample will be updated then.
